name: crash-companions-v1
title: Crash site, companions three against three
about: The crash_site_grove start save. Side A plays Gale, Astarion and Lae'zel, side B Karlach, Wyll and Minthara, every member set to level 1 by the arena's setup. The teams are not mirrors: a pairing swaps the sides on the same seed so team strength cancels, and the side-A win rate shows what is left. The spawn points are the ones live check 5 used.
draft: its spawns are 0.50 m apart in height (A y 5.1, B y 5.6): the F2 rule (bg3bench.arena.check_geometry, the mod's arena.setup) needs under 0.3 m; new spawns come from a live height read (2026-11-02)
